english.title: Take motor vehicle into Blackwall Tunnel that contravenes weight / size restrictions
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), took a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE..) into the Blackwall Tunnel, which had

(A)_[a weight of more than 44,000 kilograms]_
(B)_[an axle load of more than 10,000 kilograms for a single non-driving axle]
(C)_[an axle load of more than 11,500 kilograms for a single driving axle]_
(D)_[a width of more than 2.9 metres]_
(E)_[a rigid length of more than 18.65 metres]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(14) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
